description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - cue desk: look at the desk and hold steady to light up today's three tasks, tick one off as you finish it, and when you stand up it gives one resume line naming the first unfinished task (or says all three are done); standing up is your own tap, not a sensor detection; the three tasks are your preset, not a calendar sync; session memory only.
name: cue-desk
